name: Schützenstüble Pfronten
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Schützenstüble Pfronten in Pfronten** – a cozy mountain inn nestled in the heart of the **Allgäu**, just a stone’s throw from the **Tirol** border. Here, traditional Tyrolean hospitality meets rustic charm, inviting you to savor hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Schweinsbraten**, and **Obazda** while enjoying panoramic views of the **Alps**.

Whether you’re seeking a warm retreat after a day on the slopes of **Pfronten’s** ski resorts or a relaxed spot to unwind with a glass of local **Bier** or **Apfelwein**, the Schützenstüble offers a welcoming atmosphere year-round. Don’t miss their famous **Käsespätzle**—a must-try for any visitor to the region!

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck** and **Garmisch-Partenkirchen**, this hidden gem is the perfect stop for travelers exploring the beauty of the Bavarian and Tyrolean countryside. **Prost!**
